subject: Medford Poet Laureate Vijaya Sundaram
overview: The body met to interview and introduce incoming Medford Poet Laureate Vijaya Sundaram and feature a live musical performance. The center also provided updates on its brick-based fundraising campaign and upcoming organizational elections.

items.title: Introduction and Opening Poem
items.summary: Host Terry Carter introduced the evening's guest and performed an original poem titled 'The Refreshing' to mark the transition of the city's Poet Laureate position.

items.title: Interview with Vijaya Sundaram
items.summary: Incoming Poet Laureate Vijaya Sundaram discussed her life as an immigrant and educator, the cultural nuances of Eye contact and communication styles between India and the US, and her vision for intergenerational poetry workshops.

items.title: Poetry Reading
items.summary: Sundaram performed a reading of two poems, 'My Body' and 'Here's the Thing,' from her recently published collection 'Fractured Lens.'

items.title: West Medford Community Center Announcements
items.summary: The center provided updates on the 'Brick by Brick' fundraiser, an annual meeting scheduled for September 17, and current enrollment for the after-school youth program.

items.title: Musical Performance
items.summary: Vocalist Erin Hogan and bassist Ike Sturm performed a program of folk and jazz, including covers of Joni Mitchell and Sandy Denny as well as original pieces dedicated to social justice and family.
